name: Exp_PercentageCrossoverChannel_System
summary: This EA trades based on a Percentage Crossover Channel system, generating buy signals when price crosses above the upper percentage channel boundary and sell signals when crossing below the lower boundary. It is a systematic breakout-style strategy that uses percentage-based dynamic channel calculations to identify trend initiation points. The system likely combines channel breakouts with crossover confirmation for trade entry.
summary_zh: 该EA基于百分比交叉通道系统进行交易，当价格突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。它是一种系统化的突破型策略，使用基于百分比的动态通道计算来识别趋势启动点。该系统可能结合通道突破与交叉确认来触发入场信号。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于百分比通道的突破交易系统，通道上下轨由价格的百分比偏移计算得出，形成动态支撑和阻力带。入场条件为价格向上突破通道上轨时开多单，向下突破通道下轨时开空单，属于典型的突破策略逻辑。出场条件可能包括价格回落至通道内部时平仓、固定止盈止损或通道反向突破时平仓。仓位管理方面，从文件名无法判断是否使用了动态仓位调整，但通常会使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA可能设置了止损和止盈参数，但具体的风险控制机制需要查看源码才能确认。百分比通道相比固定点数通道具有自适应价格波动水平的优势，能在不同市场条件下动态调整通道宽度。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is a percentage-based channel breakout trading system where the upper and lower channel bands are calculated as percentage offsets from price, forming dynamic support and resistance zones. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the upper channel band and a sell when price breaks below the lower band, following classic breakout logic. Exit conditions likely include closing positions when price retreats back inside the channel, using fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels, or closing on a reverse channel breakout. Position sizing details cannot be confirmed from the filename alone, but typical implementations use either fixed lot sizes or equity-based lot calculation. Money management aspects may include configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters, though the specific risk controls require source code review to verify. The percentage-based channel approach has an inherent advantage over fixed-pip channels by self-adjusting to different price levels and volatility conditions across various market environments.
